title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the diffusion-type equation satisfied by u(x,t).

title: Diffusion Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify the correct diffusion coefficient as hbar/2m.

title: Boundary Influence
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the presence of the boundary affects u(0,t) over time.

title: Energy Range Contribution
description: Important Criteria: The student must determine the range of epsilon_k that significantly contributes to u(0,t) when the boundary is felt.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrect assumptions about the immediate influence of the boundary.
